says: In today's lead tooling, botpush.mjs refuses every branch push when the worktree has no refs/notes/fabrika ('botpush: no refs/notes/fabrika here; sign the commits before pushing'), while decision 0164 has botpush push plain commits with no sign step, after 0161 dropped the step signature.
proof: PR 1591's fix round (field/runs/2026-11-18-t753-l16-full-depth-fix1.json) ran botpush.mjs on plain commits in a cloud worktree and got that refusal; botpush.mjs:108-112 checks git rev-parse --verify -q refs/notes/fabrika before any non-draft push. .decisions/0164-the-bot-stays-without-signing.md shows 'node .agents/skills/lead/scripts/botpush.mjs <tree> fabrikalfa/<branch>' after a plain commit, and says no sign step comes back.
cost: An agent following 0164 cannot push as the bot and falls back to a plain git push as the person's login, which is the identity 0164 moved agent work away from.
